title: Hotel Booking & Booking.com Live Scraper Input

bookingUrl.title: Booking.com Destination URL
bookingUrl.description: Direct Booking.com city/region URL to live-scrape real-time hotel records, HD images, reviews, and rates.

destination.title: Destination City
destination.description: City filter (e.g. Riom, Marrakech, Paris, Tokyo, Dubai, or 'All Destinations 🌍').

liveScrape.title: Enable Live Booking.com Scraping
liveScrape.description: If true, connects directly to Booking.com using anti-bot bypass to retrieve live hotel prices, photos, and ratings.

currency.title: Pricing Currency
currency.description: Target currency for rate conversion and quotes.

minStars.title: Minimum Star Rating
minStars.description: Minimum hotel star rating (1 to 5 stars).

checkinDaysFromNow.title: Check-in Offset (Days from Today)
checkinDaysFromNow.description: Number of days from now for sample reservation simulation.

stayNights.title: Length of Stay (Nights)
stayNights.description: Number of consecutive nights to price.

searchQuery.title: Keyword Search
searchQuery.description: Search by hotel name, address, or landmark.

apiKey.title: Apify API Token / Custom Key
apiKey.description: Optional Apify API token or custom authentication key for MCP and programmatic triggers.
